messages:
kevin_privacy: Hey — ACME (tenant acme-prod) reported that their GDPR erasure call to /v1/tenants/acme-prod/erase (req id `req-0a1b2c`) is timing out (504) and sometimes returning 401. They're also seeing a billing spike corresponding to retries. Can SRE + ops triage? cc @maria_ops @liam_sre

jon_support: Ack — thanks. Can you paste the original curl/headers they used and invoice id? we need to correlate billing and API logs.

kevin_privacy: Customer sent this repro: `curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/tenants/acme-prod/erase -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" -d '{"subject_id":"user-1234"}'` — invoice `INV-ACME-2026-03`. They say spikes started ~2026-03-12T14:10Z.

maria_ops: Noted. We saw an anomaly in the billing pipeline for acme-prod around that window — large number of retry events. Possibly client retries + server timeouts. We should stop automatic retries for erase calls if backend indicates transient auth/KMS errors. I'll open a ticket.

liam_sre: On it. Quick checks: 1) correlate proxy and backend logs for `req-0a1b2c` 2) check KMS/HSM errors on dedicated hosts. Commands: 
```
kubectl -n inference logs -l tenant=acme-prod --since=2h | grep req-0a1b2c -n
kubectl -n infra logs deploy/kms-client --since=2h | grep -i handshake
```

sre-oncall: I pulled proxy logs: multiple upstream timeouts to `inference-backend-02` at 14:11:02. Backend shows repeated `KMS_DECRYPT_ERROR: handshake_failure` followed by retry loops.

audit-bot: ERASURE_EVENT req="req-0a1b2c" tenant="acme-prod" status=TIMEOUT attempts=4 backend="inference-backend-02" kms_status=HSM_HANDSHAKE_FAILED

maria_ops: That matches billing — each retry counted as billable tokens. Customer charged for 4 attempts. We should consider issuing credit if this is our infra failure. Also need to provide deletion evidence timeline (we can't claim deletion until KMS decrypt/wipe succeeded).

kevin_privacy: Customer wants confirmation that data isn't left on sub-processors or backups. What minimal audit evidence do we provide while we resolve the HSM handshake?

liam_sre: Short answer: mark the erase as "pending due to KMS" in our DB and capture these artifacts: 1) request id and timestamps 2) backend error logs showing HSM failure 3) KMS vendor incident id if available 4) proof of queueing pending deletes. I can generate a signed receipt: `erase-pending://acme-prod/req-0a1b2c` with timestamps.

jon_support: Customer-facing next steps: 1) acknowledge, share expected timeline 2) give them the pending erase receipt + error logs sanitized 3) offer billing credit for retries if we confirm infra fault. I'll draft msg once we have the receipts.

maria_ops: Mitigation options: a) flip erase path to DB-flag-only (soft delete) to avoid KMS until vendor fixes (quick toggle) b) throttle client retries at API gateway to avoid billing amplification c) coordinate with KMS vendor to expedite certificate/handshake fix. I can flip a feature flag for acme-prod: `rwctl feature-set acme-prod erase_use_kms=false` and set TTL 2h while vendor fixes. Anyone object?

liam_sre: Fine as short-term mitigation. Note: soft-delete still counts as a deletion workflow step for DPA, but we must document it's pending cryptographic wipe. Also need change in our rollback/on-complete path to perform final cryptographic delete once KMS fixed.

sre-oncall: I'll run the repro against a staging tenant to reproduce the handshake: `python infra/scripts/repro_erase.py --tenant acme-prod --req req-0a1b2c` and capture full stack traces. Will paste correlation ids.

kevin_privacy: Thanks. After we have logs + pending receipt I'll coordinate legal-safe language for the customer (don't say "deleted" until KMS confirms). Also need to know if any backups/sub-processors have copies — @maria_ops will query storage team and list sub-processors.

maria_ops: Opening support ticket SUP-14287, assigning to storage + infra + kms vendor. Proposed timeline: feature-flag flip at 15:30 UTC, run repro + collect artifacts by 16:00 UTC, vendor ETA requested within 2 hours. I'll also recommend a goodwill credit for the retries in invoice `INV-ACME-2026-03`.

liam_sre: Update 15:45 UTC — vendor confirmed an expired client cert on their HSM cluster caused the handshake failures; rotation job failed with `exit code 2`. Root cause: vendor automation bug. They gave incident id `VENDOR-HSM-786`. Recovery plan: vendor will rotate certs, we will verify decrypts, then run final erase pass for any pending items.

kevin_privacy: Good. Action items: @maria_ops send customer pending receipt + sanitized logs + timeline; @jon_support prepare credit proposal; @liam_sre coordinate final erase after KMS recovery; @sre-oncall keep collecting correlation ids. I'll update customer once we have final confirmation.

jon_support: Draft msg ready — will wait for sanitized logs then send. :white_check_mark:

maria_ops: Ticket SUP-14287 updated with vendor id and assigned owners. I'll include a short audit bundle for customer once we have final wipe confirmation.

liam_sre: Marking thread resolved for SRE once final erase succeeded. Will post follow-up when done.
